routes.name: Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao

note: Laos, read in the Lao Trade Portal's datasheet for the Permit for Foreign Labour to Work in Lao (laotradeportal.gov.la, formality MoLSW-SDED-7, last modified 9 January 2018; fees under the Ministry of Labour and Social Welfare's notice 0295/MOLSW of 15 February 2012), on 2026-10-30. The legal entity that imported the worker under its approved quota applies at the Skill Development and Employment Department's offices; the worker enters on a working visa from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and, once in Laos, takes a multiple visa from its Consular Department, so the permit is read as obtained in country; it is for the named employer, position and period (work for the sponsor). It is valid 12 months and renewed, for at most four consecutive years, after which the worker returns home for two years before a renewal. Its fee is LAK 60,000 (service 50,000 plus application 10,000), as the datasheet states it from the 2012 notice; it may since have changed. The stay permit itself (the Ministry of Public Security's), permanent residence and naturalisation aren't read.

Foreign labour can only work in Lao PDF for the consecutive period of the ... maximum of 4 years ... How long will the formality be valid for? (in date? months) YES 12 ...
